hero.title: Real piano. Your range. Just sing.
hero.lead: Scalita plays scales on a Salamander Grand Piano while you sing along. Set your vocal range once and every exercise transposes to fit it.
hero.tagline: Simple scales. Real piano. No nonsense.

how.title: Three steps, and that is the app
how.lead: Nothing to read first, nothing to sign up for.

steps.title: Set your range
steps.body: Sing into your phone and Scalita finds your lowest and highest note. Or pick a voice type and skip it.

steps.title: Pick a scale or a routine
steps.body: 21 scales and 14 routines are built in. Not sure which? Answer two questions and Find My Warmup picks for you.

steps.title: Sing along
steps.body: The piano plays the pattern, moves up a key, and plays it again, all inside the range you set.

how.pianoNote: Real Salamander Grand Piano samples across all 88 keys, A0 to C8. However low or high you sing, there is a recorded note for it.

harmony.title: Harmony training
harmony.lead: Record one line. Sing a second over the top of it and hear them together. Up to four parts, and a part can be a take from the microphone, a file you already had, or a scale the app plays.

points.title: Say what you are singing
points.body: Tell Scalita that a part sits a third, a fifth or an octave above the bottom voice and it judges the interval you were aiming for. Without that, a fourth sung where a third was meant reads as perfectly in tune, because it is.

points.title: Tuned the way singers tune
points.body: Intervals are judged against just intonation rather than equal temperament, so a major third is allowed to sit about fourteen cents flat. Which is where a singer actually puts it.

points.title: A picture you can keep
points.body: Four contours drawn over each other on a named pitch grid, a thread of light where two voices lock, and one image of the finished harmony that can leave the phone.

harmony.note: Recording is free. So are four parts, and any length. Pro only comes in if you want to keep more than one saved harmony, and you can always build another in full and keep that one instead.
harmony.alt: Harmony training: four vocal parts drawn over a named pitch grid

features.title: And when you want to go further
features.lead: The rest of the app, in four pieces. None of it is in your way on day one.

groups.title: Warmups that answer back
groups.body: Find My Warmup asks how your voice feels today and what you want to work on, then picks the routine and sets the tempo. Adaptive Mode drops the plan entirely: after each exercise you say how it went and the next one adjusts. Tell it you have ten minutes and it paces the session to fit, cooldown included.

groups.title: Hear yourself properly
groups.body: Put earphones on and a live trail shows where you land on every note, green on pitch and amber when you drift. Pitch targeting narrows it to one key at a time, and now it keeps your takes: the audio, the pitch line and what the keyboard was doing, so you can open one next week and hear whether anything moved.

groups.title: Registers most apps ignore
groups.body: Most warmup apps stop at chest and head voice. Set a range for each register you actually use and three dedicated routines open up: the rattle under your chest voice, the flute tone above your range, and the whistle above that. Mark your voice break too, and exercises build around it.

groups.title: Make your own
groups.body: Build scales and routines from scratch: intervals, syllables, tempos, starting notes. Or sing or play a pattern into the Scale Detector and it writes the notes down for you. Rebuilt for 1.9.0, it needs about half as many corrections on real singing, and it flags the notes that were a coin toss so you know where to look.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy - Scalita
privacy.description: Privacy Policy for Scalita, the vocal warmup app for singers.
privacy.body:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 31, 2026

Scalita ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information when you use our mobile application Scalita (the "App").

Our Privacy Commitment

Scalita is designed with privacy in mind. We believe you should be able to warm up your voice without being tracked, profiled, or monetized. Here's our commitment:

  • No accounts required - You don't need to create an account or sign in to use Scalita.
  • No personal data collection - We don't collect, store, or transmit any personal information.
  • No tracking or analytics - We don't use any analytics services, tracking pixels, or user behavior monitoring.
  • No ads - We don't display advertisements and don't share data with ad networks.
  • Offline-first - The app works entirely offline. Your data never leaves your device.

Data Storage

Everything you create in Scalita is stored locally on your device only. This includes:

  • Your vocal range and register settings
  • Custom scales you create
  • Custom routines you create
  • Practice takes you record in pitch targeting, and the audio of any harmony you save
  • App preferences (language, notation style, tempo settings)

This data is never transmitted to our servers or any third parties, because we do not have servers that collect user data.

Microphone Access

Scalita asks for microphone permission for the features that listen to you sing: vocal range detection, the pitch monitor, pitch targeting, the Scale Detector, and harmony training. In all of them:

  • Audio is processed on your device. It is never transmitted anywhere, and we have no servers for it to be transmitted to.
  • Range detection, the pitch monitor and the Scale Detector do not keep the audio they listen to. It is analysed as it arrives and then discarded.
  • Two features do save audio on your device, because that is the point of them: a practice take in pitch targeting, and the parts of a harmony in harmony training. Those recordings are written to Scalita's own private storage on your phone.
  • Saved recordings stay on your phone until you remove them. Deleting a take, deleting a harmony, or uninstalling the app removes them.
  • Nothing you record is uploaded, shared automatically, or seen by us. Sharing the picture of a finished harmony is something you choose to do, and what leaves the phone is an image.
  • You can skip all of these features and set your range manually.
  • You can revoke microphone permission at any time in your device settings.

In-App Purchases

Scalita offers an optional one-time Pro purchase through Google Play. The purchase transaction is handled entirely by Google Play, and we do not receive or store any payment information. Please refer to Google's Privacy Policy for information about how Google handles purchase data.

Export/Import Feature

You can export your routines and settings as a JSON file to share or backup. This file is created locally on your device. When you share it, you control where it goes. We never see or access these files.

Children's Privacy

Scalita does not knowingly collect any personal information from anyone, including children under the age of 13. Since we don't collect data, there is no special data handling for children.

Third-Party Services

Scalita uses the following third-party services:

  • Google Play Billing - For processing Pro purchases (optional). See Google's Privacy Policy.

We do not use any analytics, crash reporting, or advertising services.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

  • Email: hi@dominguezpablo.com
  • Website: scalita.com/support

support.title: Support - Scalita
support.description: Get help and support for Scalita, the vocal warmup app for singers.
support.body:
How can I help?

Got a question, found a bug, or just want to say hi? I'd love to hear from you.

Questions, Bugs, or Ideas?

Bug reports, feature ideas, questions, whatever. I typically respond within 24-48 hours.

Support on Ko-fi

Love Scalita? Help support ongoing development

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Scalita really free?

Yes! Scalita is free to use with all 21 built-in scales, all 14 built-in routines, and all playback features. Harmony training and the Scale Detector are free too, microphone and all. You can create up to 3 custom scales, 1 custom routine and 1 saved harmony for free. Pro ($4.99 one-time) lifts those caps and unlocks the practice recorder in pitch targeting.

Does Scalita work offline?

Absolutely. Scalita is designed to work completely offline. The piano sounds are bundled with the app, so you can practice anywhere without internet.

How do I restore my Pro purchase?

Go to Settings in the app and tap "Restore Purchases." Make sure you're signed into the same Google account you used for the original purchase.

Is there an iOS version?

Not yet, but it's on the roadmap! Follow us for updates on when the iOS version will be available.

Does Scalita keep my recordings?

Practice takes and saved harmonies are kept, on your phone, so you can listen back to them later. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Range detection, the pitch monitor and the Scale Detector do not keep any audio at all. You can delete a take or a harmony from inside the app at any time.

My vocal range detection isn't working

Make sure you've granted microphone permission in your device settings. Sing in a quiet environment and hold each note steady for a couple of seconds. You can always set your range manually if detection doesn't work for you.
